nameOverride.description: Overrides the chart name in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the full resource name prefix (default: release name, plus "-scrim" unless it already contains it).

namespaceOverride.description: Namespace for every object in the release namespace (default: the release namespace). Agent namespace objects go to agents.namespaces.

commonLabels.description: Labels added to every object, next to global.commonLabels (global wins on the same key).

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every object the chart renders (merged over global.commonAnnotations).

global.description: Settings every pod the chart renders inherits (central scrim, helm test pods): registry mirror, pull secrets, security defaults, scheduling, extension hooks. A component's own value wins. The in-pod scrim of sidecar mode is injected by Kyverno and takes only sidecar.* values.

imageRegistry.description: Registry that replaces the registry of every image (a mirror). Empty keeps each image's own.

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets added to every pod. Names (strings) or {name: x}.

clusterDomain.description: Kubernetes cluster DNS domain, used in the Service addresses agents get.

priorityClassName.description: Default priorityClassName for every pod (a component's own wins).

nodeSelector.description: Default nodeSelector for every pod (a component's own wins).

tolerations.description: Default tolerations for every pod (a component's own wins).

affinity.description: Default affinity for every pod (a component's own wins; tpl).

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Default topologySpreadConstraints for every pod (a component's own wins; tpl).

lifecycle.description: Default lifecycle hooks (postStart, preStop) of every main container (a component's own wins; tpl).

dnsPolicy.description: Default dnsPolicy of every pod ("" leaves it to Kubernetes, ClusterFirst; a component's own wins).

dnsConfig.description: Default dnsConfig of every pod (nameservers, searches, options; a component's own wins; tpl).

hostAliases.description: Default hostAliases of every pod (extra /etc/hosts entries; a component's own wins; tpl).

runtimeClassName.description: Default runtimeClassName of every pod (a component's own wins).

shareProcessNamespace.description: Default shareProcessNamespace of every pod (null renders nothing; a component's own wins).

enableServiceLinks.description: Default enableServiceLinks of every pod (null renders nothing; a component's own wins). central sets false.

ha.description: High availability preset (templates/_ha.tpl) for central scrim.

enabled.description: Run central scrim with ha.replicas, a PDB (minAvailable 1), preferred pod anti-affinity on kubernetes.io/hostname and, with zoneSpread, a zone topology spread. A higher replicaCount and central's own pdb, affinity and topologySpreadConstraints win. More than one replica needs postgres.enabled.

replicas.description: Replicas of central scrim under ha.enabled (at least 2).

podLabels.description: Labels added to every pod, under each component's podLabels (the component wins on the same key; tpl).

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every pod, under each component's podAnnotations (the component wins on the same key; tpl).

extraVolumes.description: Volumes added to every pod the chart renders (tpl). A component's extraVolumes entry of the same name wins.

extraVolumeMounts.description: volumeMounts added to every main container (tpl). A mountPath the container already has wins.

extraEnv.description: Env vars added to every main container (EnvVar list, tpl). A name the container already sets wins. Never put secret values here; use valueFrom.secretKeyRef.

extraEnvFrom.description: envFrom sources added to every main container (tpl).

secretLabels.description: Labels on every Secret the chart renders (tpl).

secretAnnotations.description: Annotations on every Secret the chart renders.

configMapLabels.description: Labels on every ConfigMap the chart renders (tpl).

configMapAnnotations.description: Annotations on every ConfigMap the chart renders.

allowedNamespaces.description: Namespaces (regex allowed) that may copy the object. Empty allows every namespace.

autoNamespaces.description: Namespaces the object is pushed into (reflection-auto-namespaces / replicate-to).

replicateFrom.description: replicator only: "<namespace>/<name>" the object is filled from (replicate-from). Use it per object.

extraSelectorLabels.description: Extra selector labels on central scrim, its pods, Service and NetworkPolicy peers. SELECTORS ARE IMMUTABLE: set this on a fresh install only. Keys must not repeat commonLabels.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext every pod starts from; a component's podSecurityContext is merged over it.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext every container starts from; a component's securityContext is merged over it.

image.description: scrim image (control plane with the data plane embedded), for central scrim and sidecars.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty with useAppVersion takes Chart.appVersion, which the release sets to the scrim version.

useAppVersion.description: Use Chart.appVersion as the tag when tag is empty.

digest.description: Image digest (sha256:...); pins the image, the tag stays readable.

config.description: scrim configuration, the same file format as a `scrim` config file (apiVersion and kind are added). Secret-valued settings take references (env:, file:, cred:, a store reference), never literals; the chart refuses known credential fields that hold a literal. Settings the chart owns (listeners, sockets, state, events, identity, metrics, CA, placeholder keys) are set in a second file that wins. Every store needs `redact` targets that match at least one secret: a target that loads nothing stops start-up (redaction.allow-empty-targets weakens that).

existingConfigMap.description: Name of an existing ConfigMap holding the scrim configuration under `config.yaml`, used instead of `config`.

policyRules.description: Policy rules file (YAML object with `default` and `rules`, see docs/policy.md). Empty means no rules file: built-in defaults apply.

secretMounts.description: Secrets mounted read-only into scrim at /run/secrets/scrim/<name>/<key>, for `file:` references in `config`. Each item: {name, secretName, items (optional, as in a Secret volume)}.

log.description: Log level and format of central scrim and sidecars.

level.description: Log level: debug, info, warn or error.

upstreamCA.description: Upstream TLS trust for the data plane (LLM proxy and tool proxy), as dataplane.upstream-ca-file.

configMap.description: ConfigMap in the release namespace with a PEM bundle of extra roots for upstream TLS (private tool hosts, corporate TLS inspection). System and Mozilla roots stay trusted.

key.description: Key of the bundle in that ConfigMap.

upstreamProxy.description: scrim's own outbound connections through an HTTP proxy (network.upstream-proxy.*, docs/configuration.md "Upstream proxy"), in central and sidecar mode: providers, chained upstreams, tool hosts, stores, notifiers, audit sinks and identity endpoints, as CONNECT tunnels with TLS to the destination inside them. The Kubernetes API (TokenReview) is always reached directly. A proxy that re-signs TLS needs its CA in upstreamCA. NetworkPolicies must let scrim reach the proxy (networkPolicy.scrimEgress and sidecarEgress).

url.description: http://host:port or https://host:port. Empty: the chart sets nothing (scrim uses HTTPS_PROXY from its environment, if any); `direct` turns a proxy from the environment off.

noProxy.description: Destinations reached directly: host names (with their subdomains), `.domain`, IP addresses and CIDR ranges, each with an optional `:port`, or `*`.

inClusterDirect.description: Also reach in-cluster Services directly: adds `.svc` and `.<global.clusterDomain>` to noProxy. Add Service and pod CIDRs to noProxy for destinations given by address.

username.description: User name for the proxy (Basic Proxy-Authorization), with the password in the Secret slot `upstream-proxy` (key `password`): secrets.existing.upstream-proxy or an ExternalSecret. In sidecar mode the same Secret (name and key) must exist in every agent namespace.

ca.description: Interception CA: the tool proxy signs leaves for bound hosts with it; agents trust its certificate. The key stays in the release namespace in central mode; sidecar mode copies it into every agent namespace. scrim gets it as an operator CA and never rotates it (docs/kubernetes.md, "CA expiry and rotation").

create.description: Generate a CA with Helm on first install and keep it (Secret with helm.sh/resource-policy: keep, reused on upgrade through lookup). Ed25519, PKCS#8. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

validityDays.description: Validity of a generated CA in days. Neither Helm nor scrim renews it: rotate it by hand before it expires (docs/kubernetes.md, "CA expiry and rotation").

existingSecret.description: Existing kubernetes.io/tls Secret with the CA: `tls.crt` and a PKCS#8 `tls.key` (cert-manager: privateKey.encoding PKCS8). scrim never rotates it.

certificate.description: PEM certificate of existingSecret, published to agents. Empty reads it from the Secret with lookup at install time (not available to `helm template`).

extraTrustedCerts.description: Extra PEM certificates appended to the agents' ca-bundle.pem (for cluster services agents reach outside the proxy).

configMapName.description: Name of the ConfigMap with the public CA (scrim-ca.pem, ca-bundle.pem) in the release namespace and every agent namespace.

placeholderKeys.description: Placeholder keys: placeholders are an HMAC of the value, so every replica and sidecar must share them.

create.description: Generate a 64-byte key on first install and keep it (reused on upgrade through lookup). Ignored when existingSecret is set.

keys.description: Keys of existingSecret: list of {name, version, key} (key = data key in the Secret). The highest version is current.

secrets.description: Secret slots (templates/_helpers.tpl, "Secrets"): each credential the chart mounts is a slot whose Secret is a Secret you manage (existing), an ExternalSecret the chart renders (externalSecrets.data), or a Secret the chart generates (only the metrics token). Slots: admin (key token, for admin.tcp), metrics (key token, generated), postgres (key dsn), valkey (key password), nats (key token or password), otlp (key token), loki (key password), kafka (key password). There is no way to put a credential value into values.

existing.description: Existing Secrets by slot (slot -> Secret name, tpl). Nothing is rendered for those slots.

keys.description: Key names by slot (slot -> logical key -> key in the Secret), for an existing Secret with other key names.

enabled.description: Render an ExternalSecret (external-secrets.io) for every slot listed in data.

secretStoreRef.description: SecretStore or ClusterSecretStore the ExternalSecrets read from.

data.description: Remote references by slot and key (slot -> key -> remote key string, or a remoteRef object).

postgres.description: Shared state and events. Several replicas (the HPA, global.ha) need PostgreSQL: it renders state.backend postgres and events.backend from the events values (postgres by default). The DSN is the Secret slot postgres (key dsn).

enabled.description: Use PostgreSQL for state (approvals, grants, sessions) and for events between replicas (LISTEN/NOTIFY). Off: in-memory state in one replica; a restart loses approvals and grants.

events.description: How replicas wake each other after a change (events.backend). Every backend delivers from the outbox in PostgreSQL, so a lost wake-up costs latency, never an event. Only read with postgres.enabled; without it events stay local to the one replica.

backend.description: postgres (LISTEN/NOTIFY on the state database), valkey (pub/sub, the valkey values) or nats (core pub/sub, the nats values).

valkey.description: Valkey (or a Redis-compatible server) for events.backend valkey and rateLimit.backend valkey (valkey.*). The password, when auth is on, is the Secret slot valkey (key password).

addresses.description: Servers as host:port; several are seeds of one cluster.

username.description: ACL user; empty for the default user.

auth.description: Send the password from the Secret slot valkey (key password).

tls.description: Connect over TLS, verified against the system roots.

nats.description: NATS for events.backend nats (nats.*). Credentials come from the Secret slot nats.

auth.description: none, token (the Secret slot nats, key token) or password (nats.username and the Secret slot nats, key password).

rateLimit.description: Where per-agent rate limits are counted (ratelimit.backend). local counts per replica (with N replicas an agent can get up to N times a limit); valkey shares one exact limit through the valkey values. The limits themselves are in config.ratelimit (agent-api, approvals, asks).

auditSinks.description: External audit sinks (audit.sinks), each additive to the database audit log and fed from its own bounded queue. policy drop never slows a request and counts what does not fit in scrim_audit_sink_dropped_total; block makes the audited operation wait up to timeout and then refuses it. Credentials come from the Secret slots otlp (key token), loki (key password) and kafka (key password).

otlp.description: OTLP logs to a collector or backend.

enabled.description: Send audit entries as OTLP log records.

auth.description: Send a bearer token from the Secret slot otlp (key token).

timeout.description: With block, how long an audited operation waits for queue room.

queueSize.description: Entries waiting for the sink at most.

enabled.description: Push audit entries to Loki.

username.description: Basic auth user; with auth and no user the password is sent as a bearer token.

auth.description: Send the password from the Secret slot loki (key password).

timeout.description: With block, how long an audited operation waits for queue room.

queueSize.description: Entries waiting for the sink at most.

enabled.description: Produce audit entries to Kafka.

tls.description: Connect over TLS, verified against the system roots.

saslMechanism.description: none, plain (needs tls), scram-sha-256 or scram-sha-512; the password is the Secret slot kafka (key password).

timeout.description: With block, how long an audited operation waits for queue room.

queueSize.description: Entries waiting for the sink at most.

identity.description: Kubernetes identity (identity.kubernetes.*): agent pods present a projected service account token for `audience`, which scrim verifies with TokenReview. The identity issuer (identity.issuer.*): scrim signs tokens for agents that stores trust. Per-agent store login (identity.store-login) goes in `config.identity`.

enabled.description: Identify agent pods by their projected token. Renders the TokenReview RBAC, mounts scrim's own API token and gives agent pods the token, SCRIM_K8S_TOKEN_FILE and the scrim-exec launcher. Off: every agent pod is an unknown caller, which the built-in rules do not inject credentials for.

audience.description: Audience of the projected agent token (identity.kubernetes.audience); tokens with another audience, such as the pod's default API token, are refused.

expirationSeconds.description: Lifetime of the projected agent token in seconds. The kubelet rotates the file, but scrim-exec reads it when the agent starts: an agent process that runs longer than this loses its identity (injection is refused) until it is restarted.

tokenPath.description: Where the token is mounted in agent containers.

tokenReviewRBAC.description: Create a ClusterRole that may only create TokenReviews and bind it to scrim's service account (central) and to the service accounts of agents.namespaces (sidecar).

agents.description: Agents by service account (identity.kubernetes.agents): agent name to selectors `sa:NAMESPACE/NAME` (globs allowed), `scope:`, `label:K=V`.

unmapped.description: What a service account no rule maps becomes: derive (NAMESPACE/NAME) or unknown.

enabled.description: Turn the issuer on (central scrim). Needs `url`. More than one replica (replicaCount, the HPA, global.ha) needs `signingKeys.existingSecret`: replicas behind one URL must publish the same keys.

url.description: Issuer URL (identity.issuer.url, the `iss` claim), without a trailing slash. https, terminated by an Ingress or Gateway in front of the Service `<fullname>-issuer`; plain http needs insecureHTTP.

port.description: Port of the discovery and JWKS listener (identity.issuer.listen on the pod IP), on the container and on the issuer Service.

insecureHTTP.description: Allow an http:// url on a host other than loopback (identity.issuer.insecure-http, a weakening scrim logs at start-up): anyone between a store and scrim could substitute the keys, and the store would trust tokens they sign.

tokenTTL.description: Lifetime of each token (identity.issuer.token-ttl), 1m to 1h, never past the session's end.

rotateEvery.description: How often generated keys rotate (identity.issuer.rotate-every), at least 1h. Not used with signingKeys.existingSecret.

signingKeys.description: Operator-managed signing keys (identity.issuer.signing-keys). scrim never rotates them.

existingSecret.description: Secret holding one or more PKCS#8 PEM RSA private keys (2048 bits or more) under `key`. The first signs and all are published. Required with more than one replica. Empty: scrim generates and rotates its keys in `keyStore`.

key.description: Key of the PEM bundle in existingSecret.

keyStore.description: Where generated keys live (identity.issuer.key-dir) when signingKeys.existingSecret is empty, one replica only. emptyDir: the keys live as long as the pod; a new pod (rollout, reschedule) signs with a new key, and tokens the old pod signed stop verifying once a store refetches the JWKS. pvc: the keys and their rotation survive restarts; only one pod may use the directory at a time, so it needs central.strategy.type Recreate.

existingClaim.description: pvc: an existing PersistentVolumeClaim. Empty: the chart creates `<fullname>-issuer-keys`.

size.description: pvc: size of the created claim (the keys take a few KiB).

storageClassName.description: pvc: storageClassName of the created claim (empty: the cluster default).

accessModes.description: pvc: access modes of the created claim.

annotations.description: pvc: annotations of the created claim.

service.description: The Service `<fullname>-issuer`, with the issuer port only.

type.description: Service type. ClusterIP behind an Ingress or Gateway that terminates TLS.

enabled.description: Turn client certificate identity on (central scrim). Needs `ca.configMap`.

ca.description: Trust anchors (identity.client-certificates.ca): a ConfigMap in the release namespace with a PEM bundle of the CA certificates that issue agent certificates. Only these are trusted, never the system roots.

key.description: Key of the bundle in that ConfigMap.

crls.description: Certificate revocation lists (identity.client-certificates.crl-files), PEM or DER, read again every `refresh`. Once any CRL is set, a certificate whose issuer has none here is refused, and a CRL past its next update refuses its issuer's certificates.

configMap.description: ConfigMap with the CRLs (DER ones under binaryData). Empty: revocation is not checked; use short-lived certificates.

keys.description: Keys of the CRLs in that ConfigMap, one file each. Required with configMap.

revocationScope.description: Which certificates of a client's chain are checked for revocation, by CRL and OCSP (identity.client-certificates.revocation-scope): `end-entity` (the client certificate only) or `chain` (every certificate below the trust anchor, so a revoked intermediate CA refuses what it issued).

ocsp.description: OCSP (identity.client-certificates.ocsp.*): scrim asks the issuer's responder whether each client certificate is revoked before it serves the connection, and keeps each answer until its next update. Requests go from scrim's pod, through upstreamProxy when set; allow them in networkPolicy.ocspEgress.

enabled.description: Check client certificates with OCSP.

responder.description: Responder URL used for every certificate instead of the one the certificate names in its authority information access extension. Empty: the certificate's own.

unreachable.description: When no valid answer can be had (responder down, error, bad signature): `fail-closed` refuses the certificate, `soft-fail` accepts it as if OCSP were off. A revoked or unknown answer always refuses.

timeout.description: How long one OCSP request may take, at most 10s.

cacheSize.description: How many OCSP responses scrim keeps.

agents.description: Agents by certificate (identity.client-certificates.agents): agent name to selectors `spiffe:ID`, `cn:NAME`, `dns:NAME`, `uri:URI`, `email:ADDRESS` (globs allowed), `scope:`, `label:K=V`.

unmapped.description: What a verified certificate no rule maps becomes: unknown, or derive (the agent is named after the certificate's SPIFFE ID).

refresh.description: How often the trust anchors and CRLs are read again.

serverNames.description: Names the TLS listeners' certificate is issued for besides the Service's in-cluster names: the DNS names and addresses agents outside the cluster connect to. The certificate comes from the interception CA, which agents already trust. Not used with listenerCertificate.existingSecret.

listenerCertificate.description: A certificate of your own for the TLS listeners (identity.client-certificates.listener-cert-file and listener-key), so agents verify them against your PKI instead of trusting scrim's CA.

existingSecret.description: kubernetes.io/tls Secret with `tls.crt` (end entity first, then intermediates) and `tls.key`, such as one cert-manager keeps renewed. scrim reads both again every `refresh` and presents a renewal on new connections without a restart. Empty: scrim's CA issues it.

llmPort.description: Port of the TLS LLM base URL (proxy.tls-listen), on the container and the Service.

forwardPort.description: Port of the TLS forward proxy (proxy.forward-tls-listen), on the container and the Service. 0 leaves it off.

toolProxyPort.description: Port of the TLS tool proxy (tool-proxy.tls-listen), for tools pointed at the tool proxy directly, on the container and the Service. 0 leaves it off.

service.description: The Service `<fullname>-mtls`, with the TLS listeners only. Every connection must present a certificate that chains to `ca`, so it may be a LoadBalancer; terminate nothing in front of it (TLS passthrough only), or scrim never sees the certificate.

edge.description: Edge forwarder (central mode): Kyverno adds a native sidecar running `scrim edge` to agent pods labelled `central`. It serves SSH_AUTH_SOCK, loopback database ports and the agent API socket (the exec broker included) in the pod and carries every connection to central scrim's edge listener over TLS, with the pod's projected identity token. Keys, database passwords and exec secrets stay in central scrim. Needs identity.kubernetes.enabled and kyverno.enabled (or the sidecar copied into the pod spec).

enabled.description: Serve the edge listener in central scrim (edge.listen) and inject the forwarder into agent pods labelled `central`.

port.description: Port of the edge listener, on the scrim container and the Service.

socketDir.description: Directory of the forwarder's sockets in agent containers, an in-memory emptyDir only this pod mounts.

sshAgent.description: Serve scrim's ssh-agent at `<socketDir>/ssh-agent.sock` and point SSH_AUTH_SOCK at it.

api.description: Serve the agent API at `<socketDir>/api.sock` and point SCRIM_API_SOCKET at it (the exec broker, the database tool and the other agent tools).

databases.description: Databases to forward: the name of a database in `config.databases` to the loopback port agent containers connect to, for example `{app: 5432}`.

ca.description: The edge CA: its own key pair, used only to issue the edge listener's certificate, so the interception CA's key cannot impersonate central scrim to the forwarders. Published to agent namespaces as `scrim-edge-ca.pem` in the `ca.configMapName` ConfigMap and mounted only into the forwarder.

create.description: Generate the edge CA with Helm on first install and keep it (Secret `<fullname>-edge-ca` with helm.sh/resource-policy: keep, reused on upgrade through lookup). Ed25519, PKCS#8. Helm cannot add name constraints; use existingSecret for a CA constrained to the edge names. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

validityDays.description: Validity of a generated edge CA in days. Neither Helm nor scrim renews it: rotate it by hand before it expires (docs/kubernetes.md, "CA expiry and rotation").

existingSecret.description: Existing kubernetes.io/tls Secret with the edge CA: `tls.crt` and a PKCS#8 `tls.key` (cert-manager: privateKey.encoding PKCS8, nameConstraints for the Service names). Never the interception CA's Secret. scrim never rotates it.

certificate.description: PEM certificate of existingSecret, published to the forwarders. Empty reads it from the Secret with lookup at install time (not available to `helm template`).

legacyInterceptionCertificate.description: Upgrade window from a release whose forwarders trust the interception CA: central scrim serves forwarders that do not announce the edge CA a certificate from the interception CA, so agent pods started before the upgrade keep working until they restart. Weakens the separation of the two CAs; turn it off once every agent pod has restarted.

securityContext.description: Security context of the forwarder container.

storeAuth.description: Store authentication with scrim's own service account (OpenBao Kubernetes auth, Infisical kubernetes-auth), so no static store credential exists. Configure the store in `config.stores` with `auth.method: kubernetes` (OpenBao) or `kubernetes-auth` (Infisical) and `auth.kubernetes.token-file` set to `path`.

serviceAccountToken.description: Mount a projected service account token for store login (central scrim and sidecars).

audience.description: Audience the store expects (OpenBao: the role's audience, often "vault").

expirationSeconds.description: Lifetime in seconds. scrim reads the file again at every login.

path.description: Mount path; reference it as `auth.kubernetes.token-file` in the store configuration.

central.description: Central mode: a Deployment of `scrim proxy` serving agent pods over a Service, built with chart.std.component (templates/_component.tpl).

enabled.description: Deploy the central scrim.

replicaCount.description: Replicas when autoscaling is off. More than one needs postgres.enabled.

resources.description: Resources of the scrim container. The requests match one replica at about 330 concurrent streams in the load test (docs/state-and-observability.md, "Load test"): 0.25 cores and about 150 MiB. Raise them for more streams per replica.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period; scrim finishes in-flight requests for up to 15s on SIGTERM.

lifecycle.description: lifecycle hooks (postStart, preStop) of the scrim container (empty: global.lifecycle; tpl).

enableServiceLinks.description: enableServiceLinks. false keeps other Services' addresses out of scrim's environment.

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets of central scrim, added to global.imagePullSecrets.

podLabels.description: Pod labels, merged over global.podLabels (tpl). Chart labels are never overridden.

labels.description: Labels of the Deployment. Chart labels are never overridden.

name.description: Name (empty: "<fullname>-proxy", or "default" when create is false).

automount.description: Mount the API token even without identity.kubernetes (identity mounts it anyway, for TokenReview).

annotations.description: ServiceAccount annotations (for cloud workload identity toward stores).

type.description: Service type. Keep ClusterIP: the listeners serve plain HTTP and the forward proxy.

llmPort.description: LLM base URL port (agents use http://<service>:<port>/anthropic and /openai/v1).

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe ({enabled, ...probe spec}) on /readyz (the data plane holds a snapshot and every listener is bound).

enabled.description: Render a PodDisruptionBudget.

minAvailable.description: minAvailable (integer or percentage; default 1 when maxUnavailable is unset).

maxUnavailable.description: maxUnavailable (integer or percentage; wins over minAvailable: set it to null to use minAvailable).

enabled.description: Render a HorizontalPodAutoscaler (needs postgres.enabled; replicaCount is then left out of the Deployment).

minReplicas.description: Minimum replicas; below 2 fails the render.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilisation in percent (null: no CPU metric).

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilisation in percent (null: no memory metric).

enabled.description: Add the connections metric.

metricName.description: Metric name as the adapter exposes it.

targetAverageValue.description: Target average open connections per replica.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments of the scrim container, after `proxy` (tpl).

extraEnv.description: Extra env vars of the scrim container (EnvVar list, tpl). Use valueFrom.secretKeyRef with `env:` references; never put secret values here.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources of the scrim container (tpl).

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volumeMounts of the scrim container (tpl).

extraContainers.description: Extra containers of the pod (tpl). They share the pod's network: anything they hold is next to scrim's values.

extraFrom.description: Peers admitted on every port the chart's own ingress rules open (NetworkPolicy peers, tpl).

replication.description: Replication of the Secret slots and ConfigMaps (global.replication keys), merged over global.replication.

admin.description: Admin API over TCP, for operators outside the pod (`scrim approve` with `--admin-url`). Off: run `scrim approve` with kubectl exec in the scrim pod, against the Unix socket.

enabled.description: Serve the admin API on a TCP port of the Service.

metrics.description: Metrics and health. The health endpoints (/livez, /readyz) are always served on the health port for the probes; `enabled` exposes /metrics on the Service and to Prometheus.

enabled.description: Expose metrics (Service port, monitors, NetworkPolicy scrape rule) and turn on scrim's metrics.enabled setting.

port.description: Port of the metrics and health listener (metrics.listen on the pod IP).

allowUnauthenticatedRemote.description: Serve metrics without a token (metrics.allow-unauthenticated-remote, a weakening scrim logs at start-up): anyone who reaches the port reads them. Pair it with networkPolicy. Off, scrapers present the bearer token of the Secret slot metrics (key token, generated unless secrets.existing.metrics or secrets.externalSecrets.data.metrics supply it).

serviceMonitor.description: prometheus-operator ServiceMonitor for central scrim (needs metrics.enabled).

enabled.description: Create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for central scrim (needs metrics.enabled).

podMonitor.description: prometheus-operator PodMonitor per agent namespace for sidecars (needs metrics.enabled and sidecar.enabled).

enabled.description: Create a PodMonitor per agent namespace for sidecars (needs metrics.enabled and sidecar.enabled).

prometheusRule.description: prometheus-operator PrometheusRule with the scrim alert rules.

enabled.description: Create a PrometheusRule from the chart's monitoring/scrim.rules.yaml (a copy of deploy/monitoring/rules/scrim.rules.yaml) plus `groups`.

grafanaDashboard.description: Grafana dashboard ConfigMap for the Grafana sidecar.

enabled.description: Create a ConfigMap with the dashboard JSON, labelled for the Grafana sidecar.

labels.description: Labels; the Grafana sidecar picks up grafana_dashboard: "1" by default.

json.description: Dashboard JSON; empty uses the chart's monitoring/scrim-dashboard.json (a copy of deploy/monitoring/grafana/scrim-dashboard.json).

agents.description: Agent pods: which pods use scrim, and how.

label.description: Label that marks agent pods. Value `central` uses the central Service, `sidecar` adds an in-pod scrim.

namespaces.description: Namespaces agent pods run in. The chart creates the public CA ConfigMap, the agent env ConfigMaps, NetworkPolicies and sidecar resources there before any pod starts.

noProxy.description: Extra NO_PROXY entries for agents (hosts reached without scrim; they also need a NetworkPolicy egress rule).

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for agent containers.

trustPath.description: Mount path of the CA files in agent containers.

kyverno.description: Kyverno admission policies that configure labelled pods.

enabled.description: Install the injection MutatingPolicies and the namespace ValidatingPolicy (policies.kyverno.io/v1, needs Kyverno 1.17 or later).

failurePolicy.description: Refuse labelled pods when Kyverno cannot process them.

networkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicies of central scrim and of agent pods.

enabled.description: Create NetworkPolicies (needs a CNI that enforces them).

dns.description: Pod and namespace selectors of the cluster DNS.

scrimEgress.description: Egress rules of central scrim besides DNS (providers, stores, tool hosts, PostgreSQL). The default allows HTTPS anywhere.

apiServerEgress.description: Egress to the Kubernetes API server, for TokenReview (identity.kubernetes) from central scrim and sidecar pods. Policies see the API server's endpoint port, often 6443, not the Service port. Narrow it with `to` (the API server's addresses) where you can.

agentEgress.description: Extra egress rules of central agent pods, for connections that do not go through scrim: SSH to git servers with the edge forwarder (scrim signs, the SSH session itself is direct). Empty: scrim and DNS only.

sidecarEgress.description: Egress rules of sidecar agent pods besides DNS (what the in-pod scrim must reach).

prometheus.description: Where Prometheus scrapes from (used when metrics.enabled).

adminFrom.description: Peers allowed to the admin TCP port (NetworkPolicy `from` entries).

issuerFrom.description: Peers allowed to the issuer port with identity.issuer.enabled (NetworkPolicy `from` entries: the Ingress controller, in-cluster stores). Empty allows every source: the port serves public keys only.

clientCertificatesFrom.description: Peers allowed to the TLS listeners with identity.clientCertificates.enabled (NetworkPolicy `from` entries). Empty allows every source: each connection must present a client certificate that chains to identity.clientCertificates.ca.

ocspEgress.description: Egress of central scrim to OCSP responders, added with identity.clientCertificates.ocsp.enabled. Responders mostly serve plain HTTP. Narrow it with `to` where you can; empty it when upstreamProxy carries the requests.

labels.description: Labels on every NetworkPolicy the chart renders (tpl).

annotations.description: Annotations on every NetworkPolicy the chart renders.

sidecar.description: Sidecar mode: an in-pod `scrim proxy` on loopback for pods labelled `sidecar`.

enabled.description: Render the per-namespace sidecar resources and the sidecar injection rule.

securityContext.description: Container security context of the sidecar (it runs as UID 65532; the egress guard lets only that UID out).

secretMounts.description: Secrets (that must exist in every agent namespace) mounted into the sidecar, as secretMounts.

caSecretName.description: Name of the CA Secret in agent namespaces. Created by the chart when ca.create is on; otherwise provide it in each namespace.

keysSecretName.description: Name of the placeholder key Secret in agent namespaces (same rule as caSecretName).

enabled.description: Install the guard. Without it the agent can reach whatever the pod's NetworkPolicy allows.

image.description: Image with the `nft` binary and a shell, required when enabled.

tests.description: helm test pods (templates/tests): they reach the central scrim's LLM and forward proxy listeners (and /readyz with metrics on) through its Service.

enabled.description: Render helm test pods.

retries.description: Attempts, 5 seconds apart, before a test fails.

podLabels.description: Extra labels of the test pods, merged over global.podLabels (tpl).

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations of the test pods, merged over global.podAnnotations (tpl).

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets of the test pods, added to global.imagePullSecrets.

lifecycle.description: lifecycle hooks (postStart, preStop) of the test container (empty: global.lifecycle; tpl).

podSecurityContext.description: Test pod securityContext, merged over global.podSecurityContext (default user 100:101, the curl image's).

securityContext.description: Test container securityContext, merged over global.containerSecurityContext.

objectMetadata.description: Metadata of single objects, by "<Kind>/<name>" where name is the object name with or without the "<fullname>-" prefix (e.g. "ConfigMap/config", or "Service/<fullname>" for the objects named after the release): {labels, annotations, replication}. Wins over every other source; replication only applies to Secrets and ConfigMaps rendered through the shared helpers.

extraConfigMaps.description: ConfigMaps the chart renders as "<fullname>-<key>": key -> {data (tpl), binaryData, labels, annotations, immutable, name, existingConfigMap, replication}. Reference them from central.extraVolumes or extraEnvFrom with include "chart.extraConfigMapName" (list $ "<key>").

extraObjects.description: Arbitrary extra manifests: a list of objects or strings, each rendered through tpl. Credentials do not belong here either; an ExternalSecret does.
